name: Urzak Bone-Drum
source_profile:
Warchief Urzak Bone-Drum (CE)

Urzak is a formidable orcish warrior who united the Ash-Tusk bands through a mixture of military victories, intimidation, and promises of plunder. He regards weakness as an invitation to conquest and frequently pits subordinate chiefs against one another to prevent challenges to his authority.

The establishment of Blackvein's mining settlements has presented Urzak with both new enemies and new opportunities. He considers Cadorian prospectors easy prey and has begun demanding tribute from isolated mines.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 50 (source excerpt; may be partial)
